detections.evidence_quote: Here, we're talking about releasing stem cells happening through various mechanisms of action.
detections.summary: Guest explains his plant blend (blue-green algae, Panax notoginseng, sea buckthorn, aloe) is meant to release stem cells synergistically through different mechanisms with different release curves.

detections.evidence_quote: blue-green algae will trigger a release that will be like a an increase of about 25% at one hour

detections.evidence_quote: So we blended them.

detections.evidence_quote: So we started the study on chronic congestive heart failure.
detections.summary: Guest describes an ongoing Madrid/Miami trial adding his stem-cell-release supplement for chronic congestive heart failure, claiming the first ten patients have normal heart function at six months.

detections.evidence_quote: we know that there's good documentation that by increasing the number of stem cells in circulation, you can help the heart repair
detections.summary: Guest appeals to unspecified documentation that more circulating stem cells help the heart repair.

detections.evidence_quote: after analyzing ten patients or participants that have been in the study after six months, they have normal heart function
detections.summary: Interim results of the guest's ongoing heart-failure study in Madrid and Miami, ten participants analyzed after six months.

detections.evidence_quote: all we do is that we add stem regen
detections.summary: Guest names his own product as the only addition given to trial participants.

detections.evidence_quote: We have started one in January on Parkinson.
detections.summary: Guest lists further planned or started studies of the product in Parkinson's, COPD/emphysema, diabetes and spinal cord lesions.

detections.evidence_quote: We're too early, too early right now to have data.
detections.summary: Guest says it is too early to have data on the Parkinson's study.

detections.evidence_quote: other conditions that we have seen over the years where we saw good results
detections.summary: Guest says conditions were chosen where they saw good results over the years, offered as grounds for the studies.

detections.evidence_quote: There's tons of scientific documentation that many aspects of human health can improve when you put more stem cells in circulation.
detections.summary: Guest says putting more stem cells in circulation improves many aspects of health and the plant blend does this.

detections.evidence_quote: There's tons of scientific documentation
detections.summary: Appeal to unspecified 'tons of scientific documentation' on circulating stem cells.

detections.evidence_quote: the first part of the study was really done to compare stem regen with stem cell injection, and then compare any of these two with the combination of both
detections.summary: Host and guest discuss the ten-out-of-ten heart-failure result and the study design comparing the supplement, stem cell injection and the combination.

detections.evidence_quote: these are the first ten patients, and all of them after six months had normal heart function
detections.summary: Guest restates interim study result: all of the first ten patients had normal heart function after six months.

detections.evidence_quote: I would not expect that when we're done with the study with about thirty people, that it's going to be thirty out of thirty
detections.summary: Guest says he does not expect thirty out of thirty when the full study is done.

detections.evidence_quote: I'm working with a cardiologist who has seen over the years that when he combines both, that's when he sees the best results
detections.summary: Guest relays a cardiologist's experience that combining the supplement with stem cell injection gives the best results.

detections.evidence_quote: they put them on beta blockers, high blood pressure medication
detections.summary: Guest describes standard congestive heart failure care (beta blockers, blood pressure drugs, diuretics) as only reducing pressure on the heart, not repairing it, with lowered performance.

detections.evidence_quote: it's nothing to help prepare the heart. It's it's all things to reduce the pressure
detections.summary: Conventional heart-failure drugs are cast as managing pressure without repairing the heart.

verification_candidates.rationale: Quantified physiological effect of a supplement ingredient used to promote a commercial product.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Panax notoginseng, sea buckthorn berry and Aloe macrorrhiza increase circulating stem cells over a longer period, still rising at three hours.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: There's an increase in number of stem cells, and by three hours it's still increasing.
verification_candidates.rationale: Claimed stem-cell mobilizing effect of botanical ingredients that can be checked against evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Increasing the number of stem cells in circulation can help the heart repair.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: by increasing the number of stem cells in circulation, you can help the heart repair
verification_candidates.rationale: A therapeutic claim underpinning a supplement's use in heart failure.

verification_candidates.claim_text: In an ongoing study, the first ten patients with at least two years of chronic stable congestive heart failure who added StemRegen had normal heart function after six months.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: after analyzing ten patients or participants that have been in the study after six months, they have normal heart function
verification_candidates.rationale: A striking interim treatment result for a serious disease, from an uncontrolled and unpublished study of the speaker's own product.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Many aspects of human health can improve when more stem cells are put into circulation.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: many aspects of human health can improve when you put more stem cells in circulation
verification_candidates.rationale: Broad health-benefit claim backed only by vague appeal to documentation.

verification_candidates.claim_text: According to a cardiologist's experience, combining StemRegen with stem cell injection gives the best results in heart patients.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: when he combines both, that's when he sees the best results
verification_candidates.rationale: Comparative efficacy claim resting on one practitioner's observations.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Standard congestive heart failure medications such as beta blockers, blood pressure drugs and diuretics do nothing to help repair the heart and only reduce the pressure on it.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it's all it's nothing to help prepare the heart. It's it's all things to reduce the pressure
verification_candidates.rationale: Disparages standard heart-failure therapy, which could affect whether patients value it.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Standard heart failure medication lowers patients' performance even as their quality of life increases somewhat.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: their quality of life increase to some extent, but at the same time, their performance goes down
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim of an adverse effect of standard therapy that evidence can check.
